_comment: GH#429 THE [Bar Fighting] YIELD, and the one-prop-two-arms proof. improvised_cudgel shipped with no source at all; the taproom table is the craft-bench seam that gives it one. `skill_uses` outranks `requires_skill`+`on_skill_use` for its OWN key only, so this run casts BOTH verbs at the same entity and pins both outcomes -- cudgel then chore. Production is UNBOUNDED and that is accepted on the shipped food-prop precedent (CHOICE-LOG 34): inn_chef_counter and inn_copper_pan run the identical consumable-next_fight loop on this same map. The #330 duplicate refusal proved below bounds CARRYING only -- use the cudgel and the arm re-arms. `once_per_waking` is refused on its own ground: an ENTITY flag would have capped the Helper chore arm too. Walks to the table; the fixture never boots adjacent.

steps._comment: == THE WALK == (2,3) -> (2,4) -> east until the table's own cell refuses the step. A present entity blocks its own cell, so the bump both proves the table is there and leaves the PC facing it.
== THE YIELD == press_field_skill hard-fails when the id is not on the bar, so this step also proves helper L4 really grants [Bar Fighting].

payload_contains.text: [Bar Fighting] — The table's near leg has been loose since spring. You put a boot to the frame, take the weight on the turn, and walk off holding it.

steps._comment: == THE CARRY LIMIT == inventory never stacks, so a produce-only arm refuses BEFORE it banks anything (wi_game.gd's dup guard). This pins CARRYING one at a time -- it is NOT a production bound: use_item erases the cudgel and this same cast pays out again. Unbounded production is the shipped food-prop behaviour, ruled acceptable in CHOICE-LOG 34.

payload_contains.text: Your pack already holds one of those. No sense making a second you cannot carry.

steps._comment: == THE CHORE ARM, UNSHADOWED == the same entity, its OTHER verb. requires_skill+on_skill_use still answers basic_cleaning, which is the regression this pin exists for: a skill_uses map must never swallow the arm it does not name.
The RENDERED line merges the gold row (gold_once_per_waking is still unspent this waking), which is why it is pinned whole rather than as the bare arm toast.

payload_contains.text: [Basic Cleaning] — The table is spotless. Earned 1 gold.
